title: ProperPicTorsionBaseChange
statement: Let $k\subseteq K$ be algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], and let $f:C\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ be a smooth separated connected proper curve [def-sc-curves]. Let $n\geq1$ be nonzero in $k$. For the Picard groups of invertible modules [def-sc-picard-group], there is a bijection $F:\operatorname{Pic}(C)[n]\to\operatorname{Pic}(C_K)[n]$ with $F(L)=\pi^*L$ for every line bundle class, where $\pi:C_K\to C$ is the projection.

source.place: proper-case degree-one paragraph: Jacobian n-torsion comparison

proof.text: BaseChange_curve and genus_jacobian_invariant supply smooth proper geometrically integral connected curves over both fields. Proper dimension-one curves are projective, so Jacobian representability applies.

The degree homomorphism takes values in the torsion-free integers, so nth-torsion line bundles have degree zero. Jacobian representability identifies Picard-zero torsion with torsion rational points, respecting the group laws.
The classifying-map equation of genus_jacobian_invariant identifies canonical Picard pullback with extension of Jacobian points. Restrict this identity to nth torsion.

For invertible n, Jacobian nth torsion is finite etale. Clause (c) of abelianVariety_estimate_of_isAlgClosed makes its canonical extension map bijective. Transport through the representing identifications to obtain F with its equation on each line bundle.
